pageProps.title: Hong Kong Big Flower Postcard
pageProps.review: Location of the Hong Kong Big Flower Postcard. The address is 9 Metropolis Drive, Hung Hom Bay, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong. If it doesn't appear on its own, try turning on the detector and moving around the area bit by bit.
pageProps.content: ```adcard ``` Around autumn in October 2026, here is the Hong Kong Big Flower Postcard. A Pikachu wearing red sunglasses stands beside a travel suitcase. It captures the exciting flutter of being just about to depart from the airport. In the front, a yellow Pikmin dressed in a burger outfit warmly greets you. It is a postcard you would definitely love to receive before heading off on a trip. ```adcard ```
pageProps.address: 9 Metropolis Drive, Hung Hom Bay, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong
